answer: Farming becomes a raven bet on surviving 47 epochs of grading, and every haven settlement recomputes the relic schedule, so an farming party who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 47 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 16 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
